messages.author: 0efd2d7533d4b99f
messages.subject: problems with resample
parts:
Hi all,
    I'm using resamp() to resample files recorded at very high sample rates but with useful content only in the lower part of the bandwidth. If a resamp() a stereo file I get these two problems 
1 - I get resampled only the Left channel, in the output the Right channel is set to null, and the stereo flag is set to false. 
2 - the rsult I get even from a 24 bit wav file is a 16 bit signal 


Here my code and the rsults I get:
soundfile=readWave(filename,0,1,units="minutes")    # here I read one minute of a stereo wav file with 24 bit data
soundfileresampled=resamp(soundfile,f=312500,g=102400,output="Wave")  

soundfile

Wave Object
Number of Samples:      18750000
Duration (seconds):     60
Samplingrate (Hertz):   312500
Channels (Mono/Stereo): Stereo
PCM (integer format):   TRUE
Bit (8/16/24/32/64):    24 

soundfileresampled

Wave Object
Number of Samples:      6144000
Duration (seconds):     60
Samplingrate (Hertz):   102400
Channels (Mono/Stereo): Mono
PCM (integer format):   TRUE
Bit (8/16/24/32/64):    16 

How I can force to maintain stereo and bit depth of the original file ?

second point: which type of filtering is performed before/after resampling ?

Gianni Pavan

messages.author: 0efd2d7533d4b99f
messages.subject: Re: problems with resample
parts:
Hi all, again

there is another point that puzzles me a lot

the wave in my original signal is a sinuosoid peaking at 8387691. I get the same value in the resampled signal. That is clearly out of a 16 bit range, however the soundfileresampled appears to be a 16 bit integer. How this is possible ?

Here the code:

# TEST RESAMPLING
soundfile=readWave(filename,0,1,units="minutes")    # here I read one minute of a stereo wav file with 24 bit data

PeakOriginal=max(soundfile@left)                     # Peak is calculated on Left channel

soundfileresampled=resamp(soundfile,f=312500,g=102400,output="Wave")    # resampling 
PeakResampled=max(soundfileresampled@left)                              # Peak is calculated on Left channel (Right channel is null)

soundfile                                                               # the orginal file is wave 24 bit stereo
soundfilesoundfileresampled                                             # the resampled file is wave 16 bit mono

PeakOriginal                                                            # peak level is a big value outside 16 bit range
PeakResampled                                                           # peak level is the same as above - that is strange


Any hint to understand this ?

Gianni

messages.subject: Re: [seewave] problems with resample
parts:
Dear Gianni,
Yes resamp() was written for 16 bit mono files. I will try to change it, but I do not know when.
You can use the function downsample() of the package tuneR instead.
HTH
Jerome
